title: How do we write a big number in words?
description: The video splits big numbers into groups at the commas and reads each group with its place name, starting with twelve lakh seventy eight thousand eight hundred thirty from the book. Keeko raises a hand, thinking that a group of zeros should be said aloud.
teaching_notes: One idea: the commas split a number into groups, and each group is said with its place name. Ask the class to point to the group that is all zeros before reading begins. Watch for students who say zero thousand aloud when a whole group is zeros.

source: Write 12,78,830 and the numbers (a) 3,00,600 and (b) 5,04,085 in words
video_script.why: The child can read numbers up to five digits and has just met the lakh group.
video_script.substitution: The commas split a number into groups, and each group is said with its place name.
video_script.anchor: Write the number 12,78,830 in words, and two more: 3,00,600 and 5,04,085
video_script.wrong_answer: three lakh zero thousand six hundred
video_script.wrong_move: Keeko says the zero thousand aloud. A group that is all zeros is never said.
video_script.payoff_line: The last number is five lakh four thousand eighty five

final_answer.spoken: five lakh four thousand eighty five

hold_back: five lakh four thousand eighty five
maths_rules: 12,78,830: 12 lakh, 78 thousand, 830; twelve lakh seventy eight thousand eight hundred thirty
(a) 3,00,600: 3 lakh, 00 thousand, 600; the zero thousands group is not said; three lakh six hundred
(b) 5,04,085: 5 lakh, 04 thousand, 085; five lakh four thousand eighty five
the slip: three lakh zero thousand six hundred says an all zero group aloud

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step two, take the next number. The groups are three, zero zero, and six hundred.

<bookmark mark='m3'/>We say three lakh six hundred.
